research_question: Does penalizing a latent filtering update in the geometry of its future cumulative forecast CDF improve robustness beyond current-CDF, probability-space, variance-only and standard robust filtering controls?
claim_boundary: A task-specific metric inside established implicit/proper-score filtering, not a new optimizer, scoring rule or certified original method. This finite synthetic qualification cannot establish carbon-market effectiveness or publication readiness.
data: Generated synthetic sequences only. No market data are authorized by this protocol, and no 2024+ confirmation values are opened.

reference_model.ordering: slow factor first, fast factor second; Kronecker transition
reference_model.future_timing: q_t describes the state after observing y_t. Each future step transitions once before emitting its return.
reference_model.normalization: All observed future cumulative returns and predictive distributions are divided by sqrt(h). The reference stationary core daily variance is 1; no method-specific scoring denominator is used.
reference_model.rollout_prior: All methods start from the same pi and use the same nominal P. Thereafter each method has its own recursive p_t=q_{t-1} P. The true oracle recurses independently with the true model.

candidate.name: future_cdf
candidate.current_loss: Exact CRPS of the current four-state zero-mean Gaussian emission mixture
candidate.update: argmin over simplex q: current_CRPS(q,y) + ((q-p)^T G (q-p) + 0.01 sum_i (q_i-p_i)^2/p_i)/eta
candidate.metric: G is the centered CDF squared-distance Gram of the equal-weight h5/h20 future cumulative-return distributions conditional on the current state.
candidate.metric_normalization: Divide each nonzero candidate/control Gram by trace((diag(pi)-pi pi^T) G). A zero Gram remains exactly zero.
candidate.zero_eta: Return p exactly, without an optimization call.
candidate.posterior_boundary: This is a predictive decision update. It may change the odds of the two states having identical current emissions; it is not claimed to identify those states from new evidence. A ratio-preserving ablation is mandatory.

controls.current_cdf: Same current loss and chi-square ridge; metric from current emission CDFs.
controls.future_variance: Same update; metric from the centered conditional future variances at h5/h20, equal weighted.
controls.probability_euclidean: Same update; centered Euclidean metric with the same stationary normalization.
controls.chi_square_only: Same CRPS, G=0 and chi-square coefficient 1 instead of 0.01.
controls.crps_kl: Exact convex minimization of current CRPS + KL(q||p)/eta, not component-score Gibbs weights.
controls.tempered_bayes: q proportional to p times the nominal Gaussian emission likelihood raised to beta.
controls.contaminated_bayes: Likelihood (1-epsilon) N(0,v_i) + epsilon N(0,v_i+16); epsilon selected from the declared grid. Like the other eligible controls it forecasts with the same nominal future mixture family.
controls.future_cdf_ratio_preserving: Same future geometry QP plus q[1]/p[1]=q[2]/p[2], implemented by an exact three-coordinate reduction.
controls.fixed_prior: No observation update; stationary forecast. A separate deterministic reference, not an additional fit.
controls.bayes: beta=1 nominal Bayes, reported separately from the grid-selected tempered family.
controls.true_oracle: Exact filtering and future observed-return distributions under the known simulated DGP, including future contamination. Not a feasible learned baseline and not included in hyperparameter or family selection.
controls.rotated_future_cdf: Same future metric eigenvalues, trace normalization, current loss and chi-square ridge. Reflect its orientation with R=I-2 uu^T, u=(1,2,4,-7)/sqrt(70); u is orthogonal to ones. This isolates orientation from general anisotropic shrinkage.

scenarios.name: frequent_moderate_shocks
scenarios.role: Prespecified positive robustness scenario with a different shock scale

scenarios.name: wrong_transition_geometry
scenarios.role: Misspecified dynamics control; no universal robustness guarantee is assumed

simulation.maturity: All validation labels mature by the first test origin. Filter states evolve causally through the gap; hyperparameters are fixed before test forecasts.
simulation.common_randomness: Within each seed, the same uniform and normal draws are reused across scenarios to support paired stress comparisons; methods use identical observations within a scenario.

selection.criterion: Mean empirical exact CRPS over all 512 validation origins and h1/h5/h20 equally
selection.tie_break: First grid entry attaining the exact minimum; no tolerance or rounded comparisons
selection.competitor_selector: Choose the lowest validation score among current_cdf, future_variance, probability_euclidean, rotated_future_cdf, chi_square_only, crps_kl, tempered_bayes and contaminated_bayes after their within-family selections. The ratio-preserving ablation is not in this composite selector.

evaluation.primary_mechanism_metric: Exact DGP-conditional expected future observed-return CRPS, averaging horizons and test origins. The oracle distribution is used only for evaluation, never for model or hyperparameter selection.
secondary_metrics: empirical CRPS on the actually simulated observed future sums
excess CRPS over the exact true oracle

In clean_correct, describe expected CRPS on test origins whose true slow state changed during the last five observed steps, including the origin; this diagnoses delayed response to genuine state changes and is never used in selection
evaluation.contamination_target: Predict and score future observed returns including future shocks; do not replace labels with the latent clean returns. Eligible models retain a common nominal future family, so stress scenarios explicitly include forecast-family misspecification.
evaluation.aggregation: For each scenario and independent seed, mean the h5/h20 score; compare candidate/control minus 1; positive scenarios are averaged equally within each seed and then across the 20 seeds.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of the 20 independent simulation seeds, resampling both positive scenarios together; 9999 resamples, seed 20261019. This is simulation uncertainty, not a market-series confidence interval.

continuation_gate.meaning: Internal resource allocation, not a universal publication threshold
all_required: Positive-scenario mean expected CRPS ratio minus one versus the validation-selected competitor <= -0.01
Upper endpoint of the paired seed bootstrap 95% interval for that contrast < 0
Candidate beats current_cdf on mean expected CRPS separately in each positive scenario
Candidate beats rotated_future_cdf on mean expected CRPS across both positive scenarios
Candidate beats the validation-selected competitor on mean empirical CRPS across both positive scenarios
Clean-correct expected CRPS ratio minus one versus the validation-selected competitor <= 0.005
All numerical, mass, causal indexing and oracle nonnegative excess-risk checks pass at their original tolerances
continuation_gate.if_pass: Specify and freeze one market experiment with identical information and explicit current-state filtering controls before any new market score; this does not by itself establish originality.
continuation_gate.if_fail: Close this fixed geometry candidate and its grid. Do not alter persistence, states, shock severity, loss weights, grids, seeds or gate to seek a favorable result. Preserve all synthetic scenarios and comparisons; no market or 2024+ confirmation fitting follows under this protocol.

required: Gaussian mixture CRPS versus numerical CDF integration
future reward DP versus small-h state enumeration
simplex QP KKT residual and independent convex optimizer
CRPS plus KL optimizer KKT residual
current identical-emission odds preservation for Bayes and ratio-constrained QP
exact DGP oracle expected CRPS versus independent integration on finite fixtures
validation/test target maturity and no preselection use of test metrics
implementation_audit.implementation_changes: Arithmetic or interface errors may be fixed before formal execution with a recorded source freeze and review. Any post-start correction must preserve failed receipts and explicitly disclose whether rerunning is necessary. No performance-driven model edits are allowed.

prefit_design_correction: Before any simulation or performance result, independent mathematical review found that swapping the slow/fast factors with symmetric emission variances is a mere hidden-state relabeling. The misspecified-dynamics control therefore uses true slow persistence .6 and fast .1 instead. The original idea and the reason for this correction are disclosed; no observed scores motivated it.
